notes.title: CineSim Is Now Live on Steam! 🎉 Explore Cinematography in 3D
notes.notes:

– 2000+ assets for scene creation
– Weather control and environment settings[/p][p]– Timeline for animated camera movements
– FBX & Static Mesh import
